name: log_triage
title: On-call log triage
description: Read a short excerpt of application logs and decide whether to page, how severe, and which service.
writes: a short excerpt (6-15 lines) of real-looking application or infrastructure logs during an incident or normal operation

fields.service_map: the services involved and what they do, 1-3 lines
fields.log: the raw log lines, newest last

ask: Should on-call be paged for this?
Does this log excerpt warrant waking someone up?

labels.yes: a real, user-affecting problem is underway
labels.no: healthy, or noise that can wait for business hours

ask: How severe is what the logs show?
What is the main problem signal, if any?
